text: Lesson 55 The Sawyer family Listen to the tape then answer this question.
zh: 第55课 索耶一家 听录音,然后回答问题。
zh_hant: 第55課 索耶一家 聽錄音,然後回答問題。

text: When do the children do their homework?
zh: 孩子们什么时候做作业？
zh_hant: 孩子們什麼時候做作業？

text: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
zh: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。
zh_hant: 索耶一家住在國王街87號。

text: In the morning,
Mr. Sawyer goes to work
and the children go to school.
Their father takes them to school every day.
zh: 他们的父亲每天送他们去学校。
zh_hant: 他們的父親每天送他們去學校。

text: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
zh: 索耶夫人每天待在家里。
zh_hant: 索耶夫人每天待在家裡。

text: She does the housework.
She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually
sees her friends.
They often drink tea together.
In the evening, the children come home from school.
zh: 晚上，孩子们从学校回到家。
zh_hant: 晚上，孩子們從學校回到家。

text: They arrive home early.
Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.
He arrives home late.
At night, the children always do their homework.
zh: 夜里，孩子们总是做作业。
zh_hant: 夜裡，孩子們總是做作業。

text: Then they go to bed.
Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper,
but sometimes he and his wife watch television.
zh: 但有时他和妻子看电视。
zh_hant: 但有時他和妻子看電視。
